package.name: mobile_manipulator_bringup
package.description:
Launch orchestration for mobile manipulator.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - Understand complex launch file composition - See TimerAction for startup sequencing - Learn multi-controller activation patterns - Practice mode switching (hardware vs simulation)
LAUNCH FILES: - hardware.launch.py: Physical robot with C++ hardware interfaces - simulation.launch.py: Gazebo simulation with gz_ros2_control - controllers.launch.py: Controller spawning (reusable)
